newsitem.title: UK: Paribas sets 775 mln euro three-tranche bond.
newsitem.headline: Paribas sets 775 mln euro three-tranche bond.

text.p: Banque Paribas has launched a three-tranche euro-fungible 10-year bond for a total of 775 million euros, lead manager Paribas Capital Markets said.
There is a 2.75 billion French franc tranche, which pays a 5.75 coupon and was priced at 99.65 reoffer, 101.275 issue price. Launch spread was 39 basis points over OATs.
There is a 150 million ecu tranche, which pays a 5.75 percent coupon and was priced at 97.005 reoffer, 98.63 issue price. Launch spread was 36.5 b.p. over ecu OATs.
There is a 400 billion lire tranche, which pays a 10 percent coupon until August 6, 1999, after which it changes to 5.75 percent. Reoffer price was par, issue price 101.87.
